2026-07-03.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a new function, `sdei_is_present()`, to check if SDEI firmware is present on the system. The function is added as an optional consumer can skip registration and warning when there is no SDEI firmware.

2026-07-09.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function `sdei_is_present()` to the Linux kernel, which checks whether SDEI firmware is present and usable. The function returns a boolean value indicating whether SDEI firmware has been probed and is available for use.
